title.hr: Radno opterećenje i faktor sigurnosti u riggingu
title.en: Working loads and safety factors in rigging

concept.hr: Oznaka je ovdje petina prekidne sile: trzaj, kut i slaba karika troše rezervu
concept.en: Rated at a fifth of breaking here: a jolt, an angle, a weak link eat the margin

summary.hr: Objesi reflektor o jedno ili dva užeta, otvori kut, pusti ga da padne nekoliko centimetara, ubaci slabiju kariku: sila prema oznaci i rezervi.
summary.en: Hang a lamp on one line or two, open the angle, let it drop a few centimetres, swap in a weaker link: each line's pull against its rating and margin.
